definitions: An act of hitting or striking something.
A sudden disabling attack or loss of consciousness caused by an interruption in the flow of blood to the brain.
A movement of a pen or brush, forming part of a letter or drawing.
A gentle movement of the hand over a surface.
examples: He received several strokes of the cane.
She suffered a series of minor strokes.
The artist's bold strokes were evident.
She gave the cat a few gentle strokes.
